headline: Source: Jets rookie WR Cooper Jr. put on IR with sprained ankle
summary: Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr., one of the team's three first-round picks, has been placed on injured reserve with a sprained ankle, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

headline: Packers downgrade DT Javon Hargrave to out, remove DE Lukas Van Ness from injury report
summary: When the Packers face the Jets on Sunday, they won't have defensive tackle Javon Hargrave.

headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold Could Be Out Until October
summary: The Seahawks have been hesitant to provide a clear timeline for the return of quarterback Sam Darnold from the injury he suffered in Week 1. headline: Ravens downgrade Zay Flowers to out for Sunday vs. Saints
summary: While Zay Flowers was able to get back on the practice field on Friday, he won’t be playing on Sunday against the Saints.
